svg.title: Customize callout context menus
svg.desc: The Customize right-click menu page as Obsidian draws it: each role's menu as a list with its icons, ✕ and drag handles. Delete section is hidden in the synthetic heading-menu configuration, so it appears under Hidden from the heading callout menu, and the heading list's real reset arrow is lit.

text.font-family: "??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: Drag an action by its handle to move it, or hide it with ✕.
